blockers.detail: Canonical Workgraph metrics show 193 earth-scout-owned items, 47 researching, one packet_ready, zero chief_ready backpressure, and 12 canonical. Closure-first policy therefore requires selecting the stable highest-priority partially-complete frontier before opening ordinary fresh company work. The available repository retrieval surface exposes the 724 KB coordination state as one large JSON document without a reliable priority-sliced company/work-id view; directory/tree responses are truncated before a defensible current Alpha/Beta-minus-Scout frontier can be reconstructed. The prior Scout run encountered the same routing limitation and confirmed the visible ARM item already had valid Scout evidence, so no duplicate or scattered evidence was emitted. Exact closure-frontier extraction is required before research can proceed without violating stable routing.
